svg.title: Claude Code mod policies from open to locked down
svg.desc: Five managed-settings policies ordered from least to most restrictive: default, marketplace allowlist with disableSideloadFlags, allowManagedModsOnly with your own mods, allowManagedModsOnly with no mods, and disableAllHooks.
